name: The City
_: Fan work after Tsutomu Nihei's Blame! (Kodansha, 1997-2003). Nothing from the manga or the 2017 film is used: every shape is generated here from the numbers below. The four layers are a sample, bottom to top; the City has thousands.
attribution: Fan work. Blame! is Tsutomu Nihei's (Kodansha); nothing of his is used.
_stack: Bottom to top. A slab is Megastructure; a layer is the space between two slabs, with its floor on the slab below and its ceiling under the slab above. Heights in metres.

stack.name: The Arcade
stack.note: Walls of arched windows a thousand storeys high, copied by Builders from an older city nobody remembers, with bridges thrown across the canyons between them.

stack.name: The Works
stack.note: Machine towers packed floor to ceiling, girders at every angle, pipes kilometres long. The part of the City that still does something, though nobody knows what.

stack.name: The Plain
stack.note: Nine kilometres from floor to ceiling, with weather in between. A floor ruled into panels to the horizon, towers clustered along the seams like components on a board, and a spire hanging from the ceiling.

stack.name: The Hanging
stack.note: Structure grown down from the ceiling like stalactites and dripping. Killy is here, on a platform fourteen hundred metres up.

shaft._: the great shaft: through the Hanging's floor and the Plain's, so from its rim you look down eleven kilometres

killy._: the platform's height over the Hanging's floor

_trunks: Columns of Megastructure through every layer and slab, and on past the ends of the block.

city._: Nihei's figure: about the diameter of Jupiter's orbit. How deep the City goes the manga never says; drawn here from where the Earth was out to the skin.
